nina: Quick sync 1 1 1) Finalize hero copy for unified pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) 2) CTAs & routing 3) Webinar placement. Can we lock by EOD? leo: I'll take hero + benchmarks. Clare you own CTAs and form routing? clare: Yup. Planning a simple decision radio early on the page that sets a hidden field for routing. Keeps form tiny. nina: Hero drafts (short, dev focused): - H1-A: "Production LLM inference, anywhere" - H1-B: "One API. Hosted, reserved, or private. Predictable latency and cost." - H1-C: "Serve LLMs with predictable performance, from hosted to private deployments." leo: Digging H1-A for punch. Add a one-line subhead: "Self-serve API, SLA-backed pools, and private deployments 1 pick what you need." clare: For the audience split we should emphasize: devs -> fast onboarding; platform -> predictable throughput; security -> private options. Keep CTAs two-tiered. clare: CTA plan: Primary (developer): "Get started 1 free credits"; Secondary (enterprise): "Contact sales 1 SLA & private deployments"; Inline resource link: "View benchmarks & webinar". Mobile: sticky primary only. nina: Routing details: on form submit set intended_deployment hidden field and utm_campaign=unified-pages-q1-2026. Hosted routes to growth@team (SDR), dedicated/private routes to enterprise AE. clare: Code snippet for engineers (tiny): ```html
``` leo: Benchmarks microcopy: short, conservative: "Up to 2x lower 95th-percentile latency at scale compared to unmanaged endpoints. See full methodology." Link to deep dive. Avoid absolute claims. nina: Webinar UX: hero resource CTA opens modal with two tabs: "Watch recording" and "Join live". On Join live show date + small form (email, company, role) and checkbox for enterprise priority. Modal note: "Live seats limited 1 enterprise priority access available." clare: Also add a footer CTA anchor near pricing/plan comparison for enterprise leads: "Request dedicated capacity & SLA". That link should pre-fill intended_deployment=dedicated in the form. eng-bot: FYI deploy preview up at https://preview.redwood.ai/unified-flow-196600. Check form binding id=rfk-1234. leo: A/B test variants proposed: - Variant 1: H1-A + no benchmark line in hero; benchmarks beneath fold. - Variant 2: H1-B + short benchmark sentence under hero. Metrics: developer sign-ups, AE contact rate, webinar signups. Run minimum 10 days. clare: Note on microcopy tone: keep plain english, avoid marketing hyperbole. Use keywords for SEO sparingly: "LLM inference", "low-latency inference", "dedicated GPU serving" in H2/H3. nina: Small UX asks: make primary CTA style consistent sitewide; make sure the mobile sticky is above the nav on small screens; ensure analytics fire for the hidden field value. growth: For inbound routing, add utm_source=website and capture lead_source=unified_pages. Also tag enterprise leads with "priority:high" if checkbox checked. clare: I'll hand off the final form spec and snippet to eng by 3pm. Everyone drop final one-line tweaks here so I can consolidate. leo: My one-liner edit for hero A: "Production LLM inference, anywhere 1 fast onboarding, SLA-ready capacity, and private deployments." nina: Edit to hero A subhead: "Self-serve API for fast trials; reserved GPU pools and private deployments for production.", prefer simple wording. clare: CTA micro edit: change secondary to "Contact sales \u2014 SLA & private deployments" (dash style). eng-bot: Reminder: content freeze in 36 hours. nina: Great. Thanks all. I'll finalize and send to eng. Closing thread after handoff. :white_check_mark:
